mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days across all monetary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.01 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness, triggering negative equity sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05 in rolling 3-year analysis.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial expansion regimes (INDPRO > 0.5% monthly growth), manufacturing sector strength signals robust corporate capital expenditure and earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are positive in less than 50% of instances during INDPRO > 0.5% growth periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent housing starts above 950,000 units per month indicate strong consumer confidence and construction activity, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when HOUST > 950,000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% triggers hawkish monetary policy responses that increase real interest rates and reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are negative in less than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (y/y), or Rank IC < 0.01 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases and nonfarm payrolls declines signal severe labor market contraction, reducing household income and consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or interaction term p-value > 0.05 in rolling 3-year analysis.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 > 2.5% annualized quarterly growth), strong GDP growth signals overheating and potential policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances during late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 > 2.5% annualized), or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.
